summary: Hex color field with a popover editor (saturation/brightness area, hue, swatches).
whenNotToUse: Choosing among a few predefined colors: use RadioGroup or ToggleGroup with swatches and names.

props.name: value / defaultValue / onChange
props.description: Controlled or uncontrolled color; use parseColor to create values.

props.name: name
props.description: Hex value submitted with the form.

props.name: isDisabled / isReadOnly / isRequired / isInvalid
props.description: States; in read-only mode the popover does not open.

keyboard.action: Swatch button, then the hex field.
Picks a swatch; Esc closes and restores focus.

accessibility: The area and slider announce the color name (e.g. “vivid blue”), not just numeric values.
The hex field remains the complete text alternative.
In forced-colors mode the swatches keep their actual color.
responsive: Fixed-width popover kept within the viewport; the area supports touch.
customization: className and style on the field; popoverProps.className on the popover.
commonMistakes: Assuming a chosen color is accessible: check the contrast (the Theme Builder shows it).
limits: No alpha channel in the editor.
